candidates.name: Web Feature Service (WFS)
verified_facts: WFS defines fine-grained web access to geographic features and feature properties, including discovery, query, locking and transaction operations.
OGC notes that equivalent functional capabilities are available in the newer OGC API Features standard.
semantic_limits: Feature retrieval through WFS does not certify that a returned polygon is the exact legal boundary, current survey geometry or elevation sampling footprint.

candidates.name: GeoSPARQL
verified_facts: GeoSPARQL defines a vocabulary for representing geospatial data in RDF and extensions to SPARQL for geospatial querying.
It supports semantic-web representation and processing of geospatial relationships.
semantic_limits: A spatial relationship returned by a semantic query does not establish source-coordinate accuracy, legal-boundary status, vertical datum or parcel measurement precision.
